# Figure 1

This document contains the R code and source-data workflow used for the computational/statistical panels of Figure 1. All file paths are relative to this `fig1` directory.

**Panels without R code:** Figure 1A and the experimental/manual panels not represented by the scripts below were assembled outside R. Their source data or original experimental files should be supplied separately when required by the journal.

**Final correlation-significance convention used in Figure 1E:** `*` = p < 0.05 and q >= 0.10; `**` = p < 0.05 and 0.05 <= q < 0.10; `***` = p < 0.05 and q < 0.05. q denotes the Benjamini-Hochberg FDR-adjusted value.

# Panel B

## Fig1B-1

Enterococcus species alpha-diversity analysis.

```{r fig1b_1, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## =========================================
## Enterococcus species alpha diversity: single-metric notch boxplots (base R)
## Final template aligned to user's approved 16S alpha style
## =========================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

suppressWarnings({
  if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'data.table' is required. Please install it first: install.packages('data.table')")
  }
})

library(data.table)

## ---------- user settings ----------
input_file <- "alpha_per_sample_Enterococcus_species.tsv"
root_outdir <- "results_alpha_diversity"
outdir_name <- "01_16S_Enterococcus_species"

metric_cols <- c(
  "observed",
  "shannon",
  "simpson",
  "inv_simpson",
  "exp_shannon",
  "pielou_evenness",
  "chao1"
)

metric_labels <- c(
  observed = "Observed richness",
  shannon = "Shannon diversity",
  simpson = "Simpson index",
  inv_simpson = "Inverse Simpson index",
  exp_shannon = "Exponential Shannon",
  pielou_evenness = "Pielou evenness",
  chao1 = "Chao1 richness"
)

group_col <- "group"
group_levels <- c("PD_GR", "PD_MR")

## colors
col_border <- c(PD_GR = "#7CAE00", PD_MR = "#F8766D")
col_fill <- c(
  PD_GR = grDevices::adjustcolor("#7CAE00", alpha.f = 0.50),
  PD_MR = grDevices::adjustcolor("#F8766D", alpha.f = 0.50)
)

pdf_width <- 3.5
pdf_height <- 4.5
png_width <- 1200
png_height <- 1500
png_res <- 320

## box style
boxwex_value <- 0.03
staplewex_value <- 0.22
axis_lwd <- 1.8
box_lwd <- 1.8
sig_lwd <- 1.5
range_value <- 1.5
group_at <- c(1.00, 1.05)
xlim_value <- c(0.95, 1.15)
xaxis_left <- xlim_value[1]
xaxis_right <- 1.08

## text sizes
cex_main <- 1.15
cex_lab <- 1.05
cex_axis <- 0.90
cex_sig <- 1.05

## ---------- helpers ----------
get_sig_label <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("ns")
  if (p < 1e-4) return("****")
  if (p < 1e-3) return("***")
  if (p < 1e-2) return("**")
  if (p < 5e-2) return("*")
  "ns"
}

safe_ylim <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(c(0, 1))
  xr <- range(x)
  if (xr[1] == xr[2]) {
    delta <- ifelse(xr[1] == 0, 1, abs(xr[1]) * 0.15)
    return(c(xr[1] - delta, xr[2] + delta))
  }
  pad <- diff(xr) * 0.20
  c(xr[1] - pad * 0.10, xr[2] + pad)
}

add_sig_bracket_base <- function(x1, x2, y, label, frac = 0.05, lwd = 1.5, cex = 1.05) {
  usr <- par("usr")
  yr <- usr[4] - usr[3]
  h <- yr * frac
  segments(x1, y, x1, y - h, lwd = lwd, xpd = NA)
  segments(x1, y, x2, y, lwd = lwd, xpd = NA)
  segments(x2, y, x2, y - h, lwd = lwd, xpd = NA)
  text((x1 + x2) / 2, y + yr * 0.01, labels = label, cex = cex, font = 2, xpd = NA)
}

summary_by_group <- function(dt, metric_name) {
  out <- dt[, .(
    n = sum(is.finite(get(metric_name))),
    mean = mean(get(metric_name), na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(get(metric_name), na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(get(metric_name), na.rm = TRUE),
    q1 = quantile(get(metric_name), 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
    q3 = quantile(get(metric_name), 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  ), by = group]
  out[, metric := metric_name]
  setcolorder(out, c("metric", "group", "n", "mean", "sd", "median", "q1", "q3"))
  out
}

clamp_notch_conf <- function(bp_obj, min_frac_iqr = 0.03) {
  if (is.null(bp_obj$conf) || is.null(dim(bp_obj$conf))) return(bp_obj)

  for (i in seq_len(ncol(bp_obj$stats))) {
    q1 <- bp_obj$stats[2, i]
    q3 <- bp_obj$stats[4, i]
    iqr <- q3 - q1
    if (!is.finite(iqr) || iqr <= 0) {
      eps <- max(abs(q1), abs(q3), 1) * 1e-6
    } else {
      eps <- iqr * min_frac_iqr
    }

    lo <- bp_obj$conf[1, i]
    hi <- bp_obj$conf[2, i]

    lower_bound <- q1 + eps
    upper_bound <- q3 - eps

    if (lower_bound >= upper_bound) {
      mid <- (q1 + q3) / 2
      lower_bound <- mid - eps / 2
      upper_bound <- mid + eps / 2
    }

    lo <- max(lo, lower_bound)
    hi <- min(hi, upper_bound)

    if (lo >= hi) {
      mid <- (q1 + q3) / 2
      lo <- mid - eps / 2
      hi <- mid + eps / 2
    }

    bp_obj$conf[1, i] <- lo
    bp_obj$conf[2, i] <- hi
  }
  bp_obj
}

make_long_dt <- function(dt, metric_cols, metric_labels) {
  id_cols <- setdiff(names(dt), metric_cols)
  parts <- lapply(metric_cols, function(m) {
    tmp <- copy(dt[, ..id_cols])
    tmp[, metric := m]
    tmp[, value := as.numeric(dt[[m]])]
    tmp[, metric_label := metric_labels[[m]]]
    tmp
  })
  rbindlist(parts, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
}

## ---------- read input ----------
cat("[1/5] Reading input:", input_file, "\n")
if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop("Input file not found: ", input_file)
}

dt <- fread(input_file)
required_cols <- c(group_col, metric_cols)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(dt))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

dt <- dt[get(group_col) %in% group_levels]
dt[, group := factor(get(group_col), levels = group_levels)]
dt[, (metric_cols) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = metric_cols]

## ---------- output dirs ----------
outdir <- file.path(root_outdir, outdir_name)
pdf_dir <- file.path(outdir, "plots_pdf")
png_dir <- file.path(outdir, "plots_png")
tbl_dir <- file.path(outdir, "tables")
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(pdf_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(png_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(tbl_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

## ---------- stats ----------
cat("[2/5] Calculating Wilcoxon p-values and summary statistics...\n")
stat_list <- list()
sum_list <- list()
for (metric_name in metric_cols) {
  x1 <- dt[group == group_levels[1], get(metric_name)]
  x2 <- dt[group == group_levels[2], get(metric_name)]
  wt <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(x1, x2, exact = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  pval <- if (is.null(wt)) NA_real_ else wt$p.value
  stat_list[[metric_name]] <- data.table(
    metric = metric_name,
    label = metric_labels[[metric_name]],
    group1 = group_levels[1],
    group2 = group_levels[2],
    n_group1 = sum(is.finite(x1)),
    n_group2 = sum(is.finite(x2)),
    median_group1 = median(x1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_group2 = median(x2, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_value = pval,
    sig_label = get_sig_label(pval)
  )
  sum_list[[metric_name]] <- summary_by_group(dt, metric_name)
}
stat_dt <- rbindlist(stat_list, use.names = TRUE)
summary_dt <- rbindlist(sum_list, use.names = TRUE)

fwrite(stat_dt, file.path(tbl_dir, "alpha_Enterococcus_species_single_metric_wilcox_stats.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(summary_dt, file.path(tbl_dir, "alpha_Enterococcus_species_single_metric_group_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")

## ---------- long table ----------
cat("[3/5] Exporting long-format table...\n")
long_dt <- make_long_dt(dt, metric_cols, metric_labels)
fwrite(long_dt, file.path(tbl_dir, "alpha_Enterococcus_species_per_sample_long.tsv"), sep = "\t")

## ---------- plotting ----------
cat("[4/5] Generating plots...\n")
plot_one_metric <- function(metric_name, device = c("pdf", "png"), outfile) {
  device <- match.arg(device)
  x1 <- dt[group == group_levels[1], get(metric_name)]
  x2 <- dt[group == group_levels[2], get(metric_name)]
  y_all <- c(x1, x2)
  yl <- safe_ylim(y_all)
  yr <- yl[2] - yl[1]
  sig_y <- max(y_all, na.rm = TRUE) + yr * 0.09
  yl[2] <- max(yl[2], sig_y + yr * 0.08)
  sig_lab <- stat_dt[metric == metric_name, sig_label][1]

  raw_bp <- boxplot(
    list(x1, x2),
    plot = FALSE,
    notch = TRUE,
    outline = FALSE,
    range = range_value
  )
  bp <- clamp_notch_conf(raw_bp, min_frac_iqr = 0.06)

  if (device == "pdf") {
    pdf(outfile, width = pdf_width, height = pdf_height, onefile = FALSE, useDingbats = FALSE)
  } else {
    png(outfile, width = png_width, height = png_height, res = png_res, bg = "white")
  }

  op <- par(
    mar = c(4.8, 4.6, 1.8, 0.8),
    mgp = c(2.1, 0.65, 0),
    xaxs = "i",
    yaxs = "i",
    bg = "white",
    family = "sans"
  )
  on.exit({par(op); dev.off()}, add = TRUE)

    suppressWarnings(
      bxp(
        bp,
        notch = TRUE,
        outline = FALSE,
        axes = FALSE,
        ann = FALSE,
        xaxt = "n",
        yaxt = "n",
        frame.plot = FALSE,
        at = group_at,
        xlim = xlim_value,
        boxwex = boxwex_value,
        staplewex = staplewex_value,
        whisklty = 1,
        staplelty = 1,
        medlwd = box_lwd,
        whisklwd = box_lwd,
        staplelwd = box_lwd,
        lwd = box_lwd,
        ylim = yl,
        pars = list(
          boxfill = unname(col_fill[group_levels]),
          boxcol = unname(col_border[group_levels]),
          medcol = unname(col_border[group_levels]),
          whiskcol = unname(col_border[group_levels]),
          staplecol = unname(col_border[group_levels]),
          medlwd = box_lwd,
          whisklwd = box_lwd,
          staplelwd = box_lwd
        )
      )
    )

  axis(2, lwd = axis_lwd, lwd.ticks = axis_lwd, cex.axis = cex_axis, las = 1)
  axis(1, at = group_at, labels = group_levels, lwd = axis_lwd, lwd.ticks = axis_lwd, cex.axis = cex_axis)
  mtext(metric_labels[[metric_name]], side = 3, line = 0.5, cex = cex_main, font = 2)
  mtext(metric_labels[[metric_name]], side = 2, line = 2.5, cex = cex_lab, font = 3)

  box(bty = "n")
  segments(
    x0 = xaxis_left, y0 = par("usr")[3],
    x1 = xaxis_right, y1 = par("usr")[3],
    lwd = axis_lwd, xpd = NA
  )
  segments(
    x0 = par("usr")[1], y0 = par("usr")[3],
    x1 = par("usr")[1], y1 = par("usr")[4],
    lwd = axis_lwd, xpd = NA
  )
  add_sig_bracket_base(group_at[1], group_at[2], y = sig_y, label = sig_lab, frac = 0.045, lwd = sig_lwd, cex = cex_sig)
}

for (metric_name in metric_cols) {
  pdf_file <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0(metric_name, ".pdf"))
  png_file <- file.path(png_dir, paste0(metric_name, ".png"))
  plot_one_metric(metric_name, device = "pdf", outfile = pdf_file)
  plot_one_metric(metric_name, device = "png", outfile = png_file)
}

cat("[5/5] Done.\n")
cat("Output directory:", outdir, "\n")
cat("Main stats table:", file.path(tbl_dir, "alpha_Enterococcus_species_single_metric_wilcox_stats.tsv"), "\n")
cat("PDF plots:", pdf_dir, "\n")
cat("PNG plots:", png_dir, "\n")

```

    plot = FALSE,
    notch = TRUE,

    range = range_value
  )
  bp <- clamp_notch_conf(raw_bp, min_frac_iqr = 0.03)

  if (device == "pdf") {
    pdf(outfile, width = pdf_width, height = pdf_height, onefile = FALSE, useDingbats = FALSE)
  } else {
    png(outfile, width = png_width, height = png_height, res = png_res, bg = "white")
  }

  op <- par(
    mar = c(4.8, 4.6, 1.8, 0.8),
    mgp = c(2.1, 0.65, 0),
    xaxs = "i",
    yaxs = "i",
    bg = "white",
    family = "sans"
  )
  on.exit({par(op); dev.off()}, add = TRUE)

  bxp(
    bp,
    notch = TRUE,
    outline = FALSE,
    axes = FALSE,
    ann = FALSE,
    xaxt = "n",
    yaxt = "n",
    frame.plot = FALSE,
    at = group_at,
    xlim = xlim_value,
    boxwex = boxwex_value,
    staplewex = staplewex_value,
    whisklty = 1,
    staplelty = 1,
    medlwd = box_lwd,
    whisklwd = box_lwd,
    staplelwd = box_lwd,
    lwd = box_lwd,
    ylim = yl,
    pars = list(
      boxfill = unname(col_fill[group_levels]),
      boxcol = unname(col_border[group_levels]),
      medcol = unname(col_border[group_levels]),
      whiskcol = unname(col_border[group_levels]),
      staplecol = unname(col_border[group_levels]),
      medlwd = box_lwd,
      whisklwd = box_lwd,
      staplelwd = box_lwd
    )
  )

  axis(2, lwd = axis_lwd, lwd.ticks = axis_lwd, cex.axis = cex_axis, las = 1)
  axis(1, at = group_at, labels = group_levels, lwd = axis_lwd, lwd.ticks = axis_lwd, cex.axis = cex_axis)
  mtext(metric_labels[[metric_name]], side = 3, line = 0.5, cex = cex_main, font = 2)
  mtext(metric_labels[[metric_name]], side = 2, line = 2.5, cex = cex_lab, font = 3)

  box(bty = "n")
  segments(
    x0 = xaxis_left, y0 = par("usr")[3],
    x1 = xaxis_right, y1 = par("usr")[3],
    lwd = axis_lwd, xpd = NA
  )
  segments(
    x0 = par("usr")[1], y0 = par("usr")[3],
    x1 = par("usr")[1], y1 = par("usr")[4],
    lwd = axis_lwd, xpd = NA
  )
  add_sig_bracket_base(group_at[1], group_at[2], y = sig_y, label = sig_lab, frac = 0.045, lwd = sig_lwd, cex = cex_sig)
}

for (metric_name in metric_cols) {
  pdf_file <- file.path(pdf_dir, paste0(metric_name, ".pdf"))
  png_file <- file.path(png_dir, paste0(metric_name, ".png"))
  plot_one_metric(metric_name, device = "pdf", outfile = pdf_file)
  plot_one_metric(metric_name, device = "png", outfile = png_file)
}

# Panel C

## Fig1C-1

```{r fig1c_1, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## =========================
## 05_DA_16S_CLR_Wilcoxon_BH_UPGRADED.R
## 16S DA: CLR + Wilcoxon + BH
## Levels: ASV + Genus + Species
## Models: unadjusted / primary / sensitivity(+Levodopa dose) via residualization
## Upgrades:
##   - robust rank-biserial in [-1,1] via U computed from ranks
##   - optional independent filtering: mean_RA and/or min prevalence within each group
##   - ASV-level presence/absence supplementary test (Fisher/Chi-square + BH)
## Inputs in working dir:
##   - metadata.csv
##   - table_filtered_w_tax.tsv.gz   或  - table_f_even_depth_w_tax.tsv.gz
## =========================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(janitor)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
})

## ---------- REQUIRED INPUTS ----------
META_FILE <- "metadata.csv"
INPUT_16S <- "table_f_even_depth_w_tax.tsv.gz"

## ---------- OUTPUT ----------
OUT_ROOT <- "results_16S_DA_CLR_Wilcoxon_BH_even" 
# 输出文件夹为results_16S_DA_CLR_Wilcoxon_BH_even 或results_16S_DA_CLR_Wilcoxon_BH
#输出文件夹名称根据输入文件名称

## ---------- GLOBAL SETTINGS ----------
GROUP_LEVELS <- c("PD_GR", "PD_MR")   # effect defined as MR - GR
FDR_CUTOFF <- 0.10

# Base filtering (before CLR): applied to each level matrix
MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL <- 0.10     # overall prevalence >= 10% samples nonzero
MIN_TOTAL_COUNT <- 10          # total counts across all samples

# CLR pseudocount for counts
PSEUDOCOUNT <- 0.5

# Export per-sample long data for: sig + top N by q
TOP_N_BY_Q <- 50

# Optional plots
MAKE_VOLCANO_PLOTS <- TRUE

# Optional nominal candidates (exploratory; do NOT treat as main significant)
EXPORT_NOMINAL_CANDIDATES <- TRUE
NOMINAL_P_CUTOFF <- 0.05
MIN_ABS_RB_CANDIDATE <- 0.30

## ---------- OPTIONAL INDEPENDENT FILTERING (OFF by default) ----------
## Set to NA to disable; otherwise enforce extra filtering criteria.
## 1) Require BOTH groups to have prevalence >= threshold
MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_ASV <- NA_real_
MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_GENUS <- NA_real_
MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_SPECIES <- NA_real_

## 2) Require mean relative abundance >= threshold (across all samples)
## (mean of count/total_count_per_sample)
MIN_MEAN_RA_ASV <- NA_real_
MIN_MEAN_RA_GENUS <- NA_real_
MIN_MEAN_RA_SPECIES <- NA_real_

## ---------- ASV PRESENCE/ABSENCE SUPPLEMENT ----------
RUN_ASV_PRESENCE_SUPPLEMENT <- TRUE

# Presence filter (to keep runtime reasonable). Applied on ASV counts (unaggregated).
PRES_MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL <- 0.05      # overall presence >= 5% samples
PRES_MIN_TOTAL_COUNT <- 5            # total counts >= 5

# Method: "auto" (fisher if <=5000 features else chisq), or "fisher", or "chisq"
PRES_TEST_METHOD <- "auto"

## ---------- helpers ----------
read_csv_smart <- function(path) {
  tryCatch(
    readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = "GB18030")),
    error = function(e) readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))
  )
}

normalize_id <- function(x) x |> as.character() |> str_trim() |> str_replace_all("\\s+", "")

find_col <- function(df, patterns) {
  nms <- names(df)
  for (p in patterns) {
    hit <- nms[str_detect(nms, regex(p, ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(hit) > 0) return(hit[1])
  }
  NA_character_
}

dir_init <- function(path) {
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "logs"), showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "00_manifest"), showWarnings = FALSE)
}

write_tsv0 <- function(x, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  readr::write_tsv(x, path)
}

fill_unknown <- function(x, label) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "NA"] <- paste0("Unassigned_", label)
  x
}

safe_mode <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "NA"]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

## taxonomy parser (supports d__ / d_ style)
parse_tax_16s <- function(tax) {
  parts <- str_split(as.character(tax), ";", simplify = TRUE)

  get_rank <- function(row, key) {
    cand <- row[str_detect(row, paste0("^\\s*", key, "_+"))]
    if (length(cand) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    v <- str_trim(cand[1])
    v <- str_replace(v, paste0("^\\s*", key, "_+"), "")
    if (v == "" || v == "NA") NA_character_ else v
  }

  tibble(
    domain  = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "d"),
    phylum  = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "p"),
    class   = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "c"),
    order   = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "o"),
    family  = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "f"),
    genus   = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "g"),
    species = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "s")
  )
}

aggregate_counts <- function(mat_feat_by_sample, feature_to_group_named) {
  stopifnot(all(rownames(mat_feat_by_sample) %in% names(feature_to_group_named)))
  grp <- feature_to_group_named[rownames(mat_feat_by_sample)]
  rowsum(mat_feat_by_sample, group = grp, reorder = TRUE)
}

# Efficient mean RA: mean_j (x_ij / total_j) = (mat %*% (1/total)) / n
mean_ra_fast <- function(mat_feat_by_sample) {
  tot <- colSums(mat_feat_by_sample)
  w <- 1 / tot
  as.numeric(mat_feat_by_sample %*% w) / length(w)
}

filter_features <- function(mat_feat_by_sample, meta,
                            min_prev_all, min_total_count,
                            min_prev_by_group = NA_real_,
                            min_mean_ra = NA_real_) {
  # overall prevalence and total
  prev_all <- rowMeans(mat_feat_by_sample > 0)
  tot <- rowSums(mat_feat_by_sample)

  keep <- (prev_all >= min_prev_all) & (tot >= min_total_count)

  # group prevalence (optional)
  if (!is.na(min_prev_by_group)) {
    idx_gr <- which(meta$group == "PD_GR")
    idx_mr <- which(meta$group == "PD_MR")
    prev_gr <- rowMeans(mat_feat_by_sample[, idx_gr, drop = FALSE] > 0)
    prev_mr <- rowMeans(mat_feat_by_sample[, idx_mr, drop = FALSE] > 0)
    keep <- keep & (prev_gr >= min_prev_by_group) & (prev_mr >= min_prev_by_group)
  } else {
    prev_gr <- prev_mr <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(mat_feat_by_sample))
  }

  # mean RA (optional)
  if (!is.na(min_mean_ra)) {
    mra <- mean_ra_fast(mat_feat_by_sample)
    keep <- keep & (mra >= min_mean_ra)
  } else {
    mra <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(mat_feat_by_sample))
  }

  summary <- tibble(
    n_total = nrow(mat_feat_by_sample),
    n_keep  = sum(keep),
    min_prev_all = min_prev_all,
    min_total_count = min_total_count,
    min_prev_by_group = min_prev_by_group,
    min_mean_ra = min_mean_ra
  )

  list(
    mat = mat_feat_by_sample[keep, , drop = FALSE],
    summary = summary,
    diagnostics = tibble(
      feature = rownames(mat_feat_by_sample),
      prev_all = prev_all,
      prev_gr = prev_gr,
      prev_mr = prev_mr,
      total_count = tot,
      mean_ra = mra,
      keep = keep
    )
  )
}

clr_transform <- function(mat_feat_by_sample, pseudocount = 0.5) {
  x <- mat_feat_by_sample + pseudocount
  x <- sweep(x, 2, colSums(x), "/")
  lx <- log(x)
  sweep(lx, 2, colMeans(lx), "-")
}

residualize_matrix <- function(Y_samp_by_feat, X_design) {
  qrX <- qr(X_design)
  qr.resid(qrX, Y_samp_by_feat)
}

# Robust Wilcoxon summary: compute U from ranks (ties handled) => rank-biserial in [-1,1]
wilcox_one <- function(x_mr, x_gr) {
  n1 <- length(x_mr); n2 <- length(x_gr)

  wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x_mr, x_gr, exact = FALSE))
  W_stat <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
  p <- wt$p.value

  # U from rank sum (independent of what wt$statistic encodes)
  z <- c(x_mr, x_gr)
  r <- rank(z, ties.method = "average")
  W_rank_sum <- sum(r[seq_len(n1)])
  U <- W_rank_sum - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2

  rb <- (2 * U) / (n1 * n2) - 1
  rb <- max(-1, min(1, rb))  # clamp numeric jitter
  med_diff <- median(x_mr, na.rm = TRUE) - median(x_gr, na.rm = TRUE)

  c(p_value = p, W = W_stat, U = U, rank_biserial = rb, median_diff = med_diff)
}

run_wilcox_suite <- function(level_name, mat_counts, anno_tbl, meta, model_name) {
  out_dir <- file.path(OUT_ROOT, level_name, model_name)
  dir_init(out_dir)

  # CLR
  clr_mat <- clr_transform(mat_counts, pseudocount = PSEUDOCOUNT)   # features x samples
  saveRDS(clr_mat, file.path(out_dir, "00_manifest", "clr_matrix_features_by_sample.rds"), compress = "xz")

  # testing matrix: samples x features
  Y <- t(clr_mat)
  rownames(Y) <- colnames(mat_counts)
  colnames(Y) <- rownames(mat_counts)

  # residualization for adjusted models
  if (model_name == "primary") {
    X <- model.matrix(~ age + bmi + disease_duration + constipation, data = meta)
    Y <- residualize_matrix(Y, X)
  }
  if (model_name == "sensitivity_add_dose") {
    X <- model.matrix(~ age + bmi + disease_duration + constipation + levodopa_dose, data = meta)
    Y <- residualize_matrix(Y, X)
  }

  saveRDS(Y, file.path(out_dir, "00_manifest", "test_matrix_samples_by_feature.rds"), compress = "xz")

  grp <- meta$group
  idx_gr <- which(grp == "PD_GR")
  idx_mr <- which(grp == "PD_MR")

  feats <- colnames(Y)
  stats <- t(vapply(feats, function(f) {
    wilcox_one(Y[idx_mr, f], Y[idx_gr, f])
  }, numeric(5)))

  res <- tibble(
    feature = feats,
    effect_median_diff = stats[, "median_diff"],
    W = stats[, "W"],
    U = stats[, "U"],
    rank_biserial = stats[, "rank_biserial"],
    p_value = stats[, "p_value"]
  ) |>
    mutate(
      q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      direction = case_when(effect_median_diff > 0 ~ "PD_MR>PD_GR",
                            effect_median_diff < 0 ~ "PD_MR<PD_GR",
                            TRUE ~ "NA")
    ) |>
    left_join(anno_tbl, by = "feature")

  write_tsv0(res, file.path(out_dir, "tables", "all_results.tsv"))

  sig <- res |> filter(!is.na(q_value) & q_value < FDR_CUTOFF)
  write_tsv0(sig, file.path(out_dir, "tables", paste0("significant_FDR_", FDR_CUTOFF, ".tsv")))

  # exploratory candidates
  if (EXPORT_NOMINAL_CANDIDATES) {
    cand <- res |>
      filter(!is.na(p_value) & p_value < NOMINAL_P_CUTOFF) |>
      filter(abs(rank_biserial) >= MIN_ABS_RB_CANDIDATE) |>
      arrange(p_value)
    write_tsv0(cand, file.path(out_dir, "tables", paste0("candidates_p_lt_", NOMINAL_P_CUTOFF,
                                                        "_absRB_ge_", MIN_ABS_RB_CANDIDATE, ".tsv")))
  }

  # volcano data
  volc <- res |>
    transmute(feature,
              effect = effect_median_diff,
              neglog10_q = -log10(pmax(q_value, 1e-300)),
              q_value,
              direction,
              label = ifelse(q_value < FDR_CUTOFF, feature, ""))
  write_tsv0(volc, file.path(out_dir, "tables", "volcano_data.tsv"))

  # select features for per-sample export: sig + top N
  top_feats <- res |> arrange(q_value) |> slice_head(n = TOP_N_BY_Q) |> pull(feature)
  sig_feats <- sig |> pull(feature)
  selected <- unique(c(sig_feats, top_feats))
  selected <- selected[selected %in% rownames(mat_counts)]
  write_tsv0(tibble(feature = selected), file.path(out_dir, "tables", "selected_features.tsv"))

  # per-sample long (counts + RA + CLR + test_value)
  if (length(selected) > 0) {
    cnt_long <- as.data.frame(mat_counts[selected, , drop = FALSE]) |>
      rownames_to_column("feature") |>
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(colnames(mat_counts)),
                   names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "count")

    samp_tot <- colSums(mat_counts)
    ra_long <- cnt_long |>
      mutate(relative_abundance = count / samp_tot[sample_id])

    clr_sel <- as.data.frame(clr_mat[selected, , drop = FALSE]) |>
      rownames_to_column("feature") |>
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(colnames(mat_counts)),
                   names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "clr_value")

    test_sel <- as.data.frame(t(Y[, selected, drop = FALSE])) |>
      rownames_to_column("feature")
    colnames(test_sel)[-1] <- rownames(Y)
    test_long <- test_sel |>
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(rownames(Y)),
                   names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "test_value")

    out_long <- ra_long |>
      left_join(clr_sel, by = c("feature","sample_id")) |>
      left_join(test_long, by = c("feature","sample_id")) |>
      left_join(meta |> select(sample_id, group, age, bmi, disease_duration, constipation, levodopa_dose),
                by = "sample_id") |>
      left_join(res |> select(feature, effect_median_diff, rank_biserial, p_value, q_value, direction),
                by = "feature")

    write_tsv0(out_long, file.path(out_dir, "tables", "per_sample_selected_long.tsv"))
    write_tsv0(test_sel, file.path(out_dir, "tables", "heatmap_matrix_selected_wide.tsv"))
  }

  if (MAKE_VOLCANO_PLOTS) {
    p <- ggplot(volc, aes(x = effect, y = neglog10_q)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
      theme_bw() +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
      labs(title = paste0(level_name, " ", model_name, " volcano"),
           x = "Median difference (MR - GR) on test scale",
           y = "-log10(q)")
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "figures", "volcano.png"), p, width = 6.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "figures", "volcano.pdf"), p, width = 6.5, height = 5)
  }

  capture.output(sessionInfo(), file = file.path(out_dir, "logs", "sessionInfo.txt"))
}

## ---------- ASV presence/absence supplement ----------
run_asv_presence_supplement <- function(mat_asv, meta, tax_tbl) {
  out_dir <- file.path(OUT_ROOT, "ASV", "presence_supplement")
  dir_init(out_dir)

  # filter for feasibility
  prev_all <- rowMeans(mat_asv > 0)
  tot <- rowSums(mat_asv)
  keep <- (prev_all >= PRES_MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL) & (tot >= PRES_MIN_TOTAL_COUNT)
  mat_p <- mat_asv[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  write_tsv0(tibble(
    n_total = nrow(mat_asv),
    n_keep  = nrow(mat_p),
    pres_min_prev_all = PRES_MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL,
    pres_min_total_count = PRES_MIN_TOTAL_COUNT,
    pres_test_method = PRES_TEST_METHOD
  ), file.path(out_dir, "00_manifest", "presence_filter_params.tsv"))

  if (nrow(mat_p) == 0) {
    writeLines("No ASVs passed presence filter; presence supplement skipped.",
               con = file.path(out_dir, "logs", "note.txt"))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  idx_gr <- which(meta$group == "PD_GR")
  idx_mr <- which(meta$group == "PD_MR")
  n_gr <- length(idx_gr); n_mr <- length(idx_mr)

  pres <- (mat_p > 0) * 1
  a <- rowSums(pres[, idx_mr, drop = FALSE]) # MR present
  c <- rowSums(pres[, idx_gr, drop = FALSE]) # GR present
  b <- n_mr - a
  d <- n_gr - c

  # odds ratio with Haldane-Anscombe correction
  OR <- ((a + 0.5) * (d + 0.5)) / ((b + 0.5) * (c + 0.5))
  logOR <- log(OR)

  # choose test
  method_use <- PRES_TEST_METHOD
  if (method_use == "auto") {
    method_use <- if (nrow(mat_p) <= 5000) "fisher" else "chisq"
  }

  if (method_use == "chisq") {
    n <- n_mr + n_gr
    denom <- (a + b) * (c + d) * (a + c) * (b + d)
    chi2 <- (n * (a * d - b * c)^2) / pmax(denom, 1e-12)
    p <- pchisq(chi2, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
  } else {
    # fisher per feature (can be slow if too many; auto avoids huge n)
    p <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(mat_p)), function(i) {
      m <- matrix(c(a[i], b[i], c[i], d[i]), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
      suppressWarnings(fisher.test(m)$p.value)
    }, numeric(1))
  }

  q <- p.adjust(p, method = "BH")

  cont <- tibble(
    feature = rownames(mat_p),
    MR_present = a, MR_absent = b,
    GR_present = c, GR_absent = d,
    prev_MR = a / n_mr,
    prev_GR = c / n_gr,
    logOR = logOR,
    OR = OR,
    p_value = p,
    q_value = q,
    direction = case_when(logOR > 0 ~ "PD_MR>PD_GR",
                          logOR < 0 ~ "PD_MR<PD_GR",
                          TRUE ~ "NA")
  ) |>
    left_join(tax_tbl |> transmute(feature = asv_id, taxonomy_raw, domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species),
              by = "feature")

  write_tsv0(cont, file.path(out_dir, "tables", "asv_presence_all_results.tsv"))
  write_tsv0(cont |> filter(q_value < FDR_CUTOFF),
             file.path(out_dir, "tables", paste0("asv_presence_significant_FDR_", FDR_CUTOFF, ".tsv")))

  if (EXPORT_NOMINAL_CANDIDATES) {
    cand <- cont |> filter(p_value < NOMINAL_P_CUTOFF) |> arrange(p_value)
    write_tsv0(cand, file.path(out_dir, "tables", paste0("asv_presence_candidates_p_lt_", NOMINAL_P_CUTOFF, ".tsv")))
  }

  # per-sample long for top/sig presence candidates
  top_ids <- cont |> arrange(q_value) |> slice_head(n = TOP_N_BY_Q) |> pull(feature)
  sig_ids <- cont |> filter(q_value < FDR_CUTOFF) |> pull(feature)
  pick <- unique(c(top_ids, sig_ids))
  pick <- pick[pick %in% rownames(mat_p)]

  if (length(pick) > 0) {
    long <- as.data.frame(mat_p[pick, , drop = FALSE]) |>
      rownames_to_column("feature") |>
      pivot_longer(cols = colnames(mat_p), names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "count") |>
      mutate(present = as.integer(count > 0)) |>
      left_join(meta, by = "sample_id")
    write_tsv0(long, file.path(out_dir, "tables", "per_sample_presence_top_or_sig_long.tsv"))
  }

  capture.output(sessionInfo(), file = file.path(out_dir, "logs", "sessionInfo.txt"))
}

## ---------- main ----------
dir.create(OUT_ROOT, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# metadata
meta_raw <- read_csv_smart(META_FILE) |> janitor::clean_names(replace = c("\u03bc" = "u"))

sample_col <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^sample$"))
group_col  <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^group$"))
age_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^age$"))
bmi_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^bmi"))
dur_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("disease_duration"))
con_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("constipation"))
dose_col   <- find_col(meta_raw, c("levodopa.*dose"))

stopifnot(!is.na(sample_col), !is.na(group_col))

meta <- meta_raw |>
  mutate(sample_id = normalize_id(.data[[sample_col]]),
         group = .data[[group_col]]) |>
  filter(!is.na(sample_id) & sample_id != "") |>
  filter(group %in% GROUP_LEVELS) |>
  transmute(
    sample_id,
    group = factor(group, levels = GROUP_LEVELS),
    age = as.numeric(.data[[age_col]]),
    bmi = as.numeric(.data[[bmi_col]]),
    disease_duration = as.numeric(.data[[dur_col]]),
    constipation = factor(as.integer(.data[[con_col]]), levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    levodopa_dose = if (!is.na(dose_col)) as.numeric(.data[[dose_col]]) else NA_real_
  )

stopifnot(nrow(meta) == 40)
meta <- meta |> arrange(sample_id)
write_tsv0(meta, file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest", "metadata_model_40.tsv"))

write_tsv0(tibble(
  FDR_CUTOFF = FDR_CUTOFF,
  MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL = MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL,
  MIN_TOTAL_COUNT = MIN_TOTAL_COUNT,
  PSEUDOCOUNT = PSEUDOCOUNT,
  TOP_N_BY_Q = TOP_N_BY_Q,
  MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_ASV = MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_ASV,
  MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_GENUS = MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_GENUS,
  MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_SPECIES = MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_SPECIES,
  MIN_MEAN_RA_ASV = MIN_MEAN_RA_ASV,
  MIN_MEAN_RA_GENUS = MIN_MEAN_RA_GENUS,
  MIN_MEAN_RA_SPECIES = MIN_MEAN_RA_SPECIES
), file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest", "params.tsv"))

# read 16S table
dt <- read.delim(gzfile(INPUT_16S), sep = "\t", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

id_col  <- if ("#ID" %in% names(dt)) "#ID" else names(dt)[1]
tax_col <- if ("taxonomy" %in% names(dt)) "taxonomy" else if ("taxon" %in% names(dt)) "taxon" else NA_character_
stopifnot(!is.na(tax_col))

sample_cols <- names(dt)[str_detect(names(dt), "^PD\\d+$")]
keep_samples <- intersect(meta$sample_id, sample_cols)
stopifnot(length(keep_samples) == 40)
keep_samples <- meta$sample_id

asv_id <- as.character(dt[[id_col]])
mat_asv <- dt[, keep_samples, drop = FALSE]
mat_asv[] <- lapply(mat_asv, as.numeric)
mat_asv <- as.matrix(mat_asv)
rownames(mat_asv) <- asv_id

# taxonomy
tax_tbl <- tibble(asv_id = asv_id, taxonomy_raw = dt[[tax_col]]) |>
  bind_cols(parse_tax_16s(dt[[tax_col]])) |>
  mutate(
    genus = fill_unknown(genus, "genus"),
    species = fill_unknown(species, "species"),
    domain = fill_unknown(domain, "domain"),
    phylum = fill_unknown(phylum, "phylum"),
    class  = fill_unknown(class, "class"),
    order  = fill_unknown(order, "order"),
    family = fill_unknown(family, "family")
  )
write_tsv0(tax_tbl, file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest", "ASV_taxonomy_parsed.tsv"))

## ---------- build levels with upgraded filtering ----------
# ASV
f_asv <- filter_features(mat_asv, meta,
                         min_prev_all = MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL,
                         min_total_count = MIN_TOTAL_COUNT,
                         min_prev_by_group = MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_ASV,
                         min_mean_ra = MIN_MEAN_RA_ASV)
mat_asv_f <- f_asv$mat
write_tsv0(f_asv$summary |> mutate(level = "ASV"),
           file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest", "filter_summary_ASV.tsv"))
saveRDS(mat_asv_f, file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest", "counts_ASV_filtered.rds"), compress = "xz")

# Genus aggregate
map_asv_genus <- setNames(tax_tbl$genus, tax_tbl$asv_id)
mat_genus <- aggregate_counts(mat_asv, map_asv_genus)

f_genus <- filter_features(mat_genus, meta,
                           min_prev_all = MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL,
                           min_total_count = MIN_TOTAL_COUNT,
                           min_prev_by_group = MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_GENUS,
                           min_mean_ra = MIN_MEAN_RA_GENUS)
mat_genus_f <- f_genus$mat
write_tsv0(f_genus$summary |> mutate(level = "Genus"),
           file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest", "filter_summary_Genus.tsv"))
saveRDS(mat_genus_f, file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest", "counts_Genus_filtered.rds"), compress = "xz")
write_tsv0(tibble(asv_id = names(map_asv_genus), genus = unname(map_asv_genus)),
           file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest", "map_ASV_to_Genus.tsv"))

# Species aggregate
map_asv_species <- setNames(tax_tbl$species, tax_tbl$asv_id)
mat_species <- aggregate_counts(mat_asv, map_asv_species)

f_species <- filter_features(mat_species, meta,
                             min_prev_all = MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL,
                             min_total_count = MIN_TOTAL_COUNT,
                             min_prev_by_group = MIN_PREV_BY_GROUP_SPECIES,
                             min_mean_ra = MIN_MEAN_RA_SPECIES)
mat_species_f <- f_species$mat
write_tsv0(f_species$summary |> mutate(level = "Species"),
           file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest", "filter_summary_Species.tsv"))
saveRDS(mat_species_f, file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest", "counts_Species_filtered.rds"), compress = "xz")
write_tsv0(tibble(asv_id = names(map_asv_species), species = unname(map_asv_species)),
           file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest", "map_ASV_to_Species.tsv"))

## ---------- annotation tables ----------
anno_asv <- tax_tbl |>
  filter(asv_id %in% rownames(mat_asv_f)) |>
  transmute(feature = asv_id, taxonomy_raw, domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species)

anno_genus <- tax_tbl |>
  mutate(genus_grp = map_asv_genus[asv_id]) |>
  group_by(genus_grp) |>
  summarise(
    domain = safe_mode(domain),
    phylum = safe_mode(phylum),
    class  = safe_mode(class),
    order  = safe_mode(order),
    family = safe_mode(family),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    feature = genus_grp,
    genus = genus_grp,
    domain = fill_unknown(domain, "domain"),
    phylum = fill_unknown(phylum, "phylum"),
    class  = fill_unknown(class, "class"),
    order  = fill_unknown(order, "order"),
    family = fill_unknown(family, "family")
  ) |>
  select(feature, domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus) |>
  filter(feature %in% rownames(mat_genus_f))

anno_species <- tax_tbl |>
  mutate(species_grp = map_asv_species[asv_id]) |>
  group_by(species_grp) |>
  summarise(
    domain = safe_mode(domain),
    phylum = safe_mode(phylum),
    class  = safe_mode(class),
    order  = safe_mode(order),
    family = safe_mode(family),
    genus  = safe_mode(genus),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    feature = species_grp,
    species = species_grp,
    domain = fill_unknown(domain, "domain"),
    phylum = fill_unknown(phylum, "phylum"),
    class  = fill_unknown(class, "class"),
    order  = fill_unknown(order, "order"),
    family = fill_unknown(family, "family"),
    genus  = fill_unknown(genus, "genus")
  ) |>
  select(feature, domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species) |>
  filter(feature %in% rownames(mat_species_f))

## ---------- run models ----------
models <- c("unadjusted", "primary", "sensitivity_add_dose")

for (m in models) run_wilcox_suite("ASV",     mat_asv_f,     anno_asv,     meta, m)
for (m in models) run_wilcox_suite("Genus",   mat_genus_f,   anno_genus,   meta, m)
for (m in models) run_wilcox_suite("Species", mat_species_f, anno_species, meta, m)

## ---------- ASV presence/absence supplement ----------
if (RUN_ASV_PRESENCE_SUPPLEMENT) {
  run_asv_presence_supplement(mat_asv, meta, tax_tbl)
}

message("16S DA upgraded done -> ", OUT_ROOT)
```

## Fig1C-2

```{r fig1c_2, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## =========================
## 06_heatmap_16S_Genus_p05_3models.R
## Genus-level heatmap (3 models): CLR (or residual CLR) -> row Z-score -> heatmap
## Inclusion rule: p < 0.05 (Wilcoxon), BH computed but NOT used for inclusion here.
## Inputs in working dir:
##   - metadata.csv
##   - table_filtered_w_tax.tsv.gz 或  - table_f_even_depth_w_tax.tsv.gz
## Output:
##   - results_16S_Genus_heatmap_p05/ 或 - results_16S_Genus_heatmap_p05_even/
## =========================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(janitor)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
})

## ---------- user params ----------
META_FILE <- "metadata.csv"
INPUT_16S <- "table_f_even_depth_w_tax.tsv.gz" #抽平/未抽平

OUT_ROOT <- "results_16S_Genus_heatmap_p05_even" #抽平/未抽平

GROUP_LEVELS <- c("PD_GR", "PD_MR")  # GR first, MR second

# genus aggregation/filter (match your DA defaults; you can tighten if needed)
MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL <- 0.10
MIN_TOTAL_COUNT <- 10

# CLR
PSEUDOCOUNT <- 0.5

# heatmap inclusion
P_CUTOFF <- 0.05
FALLBACK_TOP_N <- 30  # if no p < 0.05 taxa

# plot
CLUSTER_ROWS <- TRUE
CLUSTER_COLS <- FALSE   # keep sample order by group then sample_id
MAKE_PDF <- TRUE
MAKE_PNG <- TRUE

## ---------- helpers ----------
read_csv_smart <- function(path) {
  tryCatch(
    readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = "GB18030")),
    error = function(e) readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))
  )
}
normalize_id <- function(x) x |> as.character() |> str_trim() |> str_replace_all("\\s+", "")
find_col <- function(df, patterns) {
  nms <- names(df)
  for (p in patterns) {
    hit <- nms[str_detect(nms, regex(p, ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(hit) > 0) return(hit[1])
  }
  NA_character_
}
dir_init <- function(path) {
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "logs"), showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "00_manifest"), showWarnings = FALSE)
}
write_tsv0 <- function(x, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  readr::write_tsv(x, path)
}
fill_unknown <- function(x, label) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "NA"] <- paste0("Unassigned_", label)
  x
}
parse_tax_16s <- function(tax) {
  parts <- str_split(as.character(tax), ";", simplify = TRUE)
  get_rank <- function(row, key) {
    cand <- row[str_detect(row, paste0("^\\s*", key, "_+"))]
    if (length(cand) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    v <- str_trim(cand[1])
    v <- str_replace(v, paste0("^\\s*", key, "_+"), "")
    if (v == "" || v == "NA") NA_character_ else v
  }
  tibble(
    domain  = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "d"),
    phylum  = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "p"),
    class   = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "c"),
    order   = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "o"),
    family  = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "f"),
    genus   = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "g"),
    species = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "s")
  )
}
aggregate_counts <- function(mat_feat_by_sample, feature_to_group_named) {
  grp <- feature_to_group_named[rownames(mat_feat_by_sample)]
  rowsum(mat_feat_by_sample, group = grp, reorder = TRUE)
}
clr_transform <- function(mat_feat_by_sample, pseudocount = 0.5) {
  x <- mat_feat_by_sample + pseudocount
  x <- sweep(x, 2, colSums(x), "/")
  lx <- log(x)
  sweep(lx, 2, colMeans(lx), "-")
}
residualize_matrix <- function(Y_samp_by_feat, X_design) {
  qrX <- qr(X_design)
  qr.resid(qrX, Y_samp_by_feat)
}
row_zscore <- function(mat_feat_by_sample) {
  # features x samples
  mu <- rowMeans(mat_feat_by_sample, na.rm = TRUE)
  sdv <- apply(mat_feat_by_sample, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  sdv[sdv == 0 | is.na(sdv)] <- 1
  sweep(sweep(mat_feat_by_sample, 1, mu, "-"), 1, sdv, "/")
}

# robust Wilcoxon: compute U from ranks (rank-biserial in [-1,1])
wilcox_one <- function(x_mr, x_gr) {
  n1 <- length(x_mr); n2 <- length(x_gr)
  wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x_mr, x_gr, exact = FALSE))
  p <- wt$p.value
  Wstat <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)

  z <- c(x_mr, x_gr)
  r <- rank(z, ties.method = "average")
  Wrank <- sum(r[seq_len(n1)])
  U <- Wrank - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2
  rb <- (2 * U) / (n1 * n2) - 1
  rb <- max(-1, min(1, rb))
  med_diff <- median(x_mr, na.rm = TRUE) - median(x_gr, na.rm = TRUE)

  c(p_value = p, W = Wstat, U = U, rank_biserial = rb, median_diff = med_diff)
}

plot_heatmap_pheatmap <- function(mat_z, anno_col, out_pdf, out_png, cluster_rows, cluster_cols) {
  if (!requireNamespace("pheatmap", quietly = TRUE)) return(FALSE)

  # pheatmap wants annotation as data.frame with rownames=colnames(mat)
  ann <- as.data.frame(anno_col)
  rownames(ann) <- colnames(mat_z)

  if (MAKE_PDF) {
    pdf(out_pdf, width = 9, height = max(4, 0.18 * nrow(mat_z) + 2))
    pheatmap::pheatmap(mat_z,
                       cluster_rows = cluster_rows,
                       cluster_cols = cluster_cols,
                       annotation_col = ann,
                       show_colnames = FALSE,
                       fontsize_row = 8)
    dev.off()
  }
  if (MAKE_PNG) {
    png(out_png, width = 2200, height = max(1400, 40 * nrow(mat_z) + 600), res = 300)
    pheatmap::pheatmap(mat_z,
                       cluster_rows = cluster_rows,
                       cluster_cols = cluster_cols,
                       annotation_col = ann,
                       show_colnames = FALSE,
                       fontsize_row = 8)
    dev.off()
  }
  TRUE
}

plot_heatmap_gg <- function(mat_z, sample_order, out_pdf, out_png) {
  df <- as.data.frame(mat_z) |>
    rownames_to_column("feature") |>
    pivot_longer(-feature, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "z") |>
    mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = sample_order))

  # order features by clustering (optional)
  feat_order <- rownames(mat_z)
  if (CLUSTER_ROWS && nrow(mat_z) >= 2) {
    hc <- hclust(dist(mat_z))
    feat_order <- rownames(mat_z)[hc$order]
  }
  df$feature <- factor(df$feature, levels = rev(feat_order))

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = sample_id, y = feature, fill = z)) +
    geom_tile() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Z")

  if (MAKE_PDF) ggsave(out_pdf, p, width = 9, height = max(4, 0.18 * nlevels(df$feature) + 2))
  if (MAKE_PNG) ggsave(out_png, p, width = 9, height = max(4, 0.18 * nlevels(df$feature) + 2), dpi = 300)
}

## ---------- load metadata ----------
meta_raw <- read_csv_smart(META_FILE) |> janitor::clean_names(replace = c("\u03bc" = "u"))

sample_col <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^sample$"))
group_col  <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^group$"))
age_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^age$"))
bmi_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^bmi"))
dur_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("disease_duration"))
con_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("constipation"))
dose_col   <- find_col(meta_raw, c("levodopa.*dose"))

stopifnot(!is.na(sample_col), !is.na(group_col))

meta <- meta_raw |>
  mutate(sample_id = normalize_id(.data[[sample_col]]),
         group = .data[[group_col]]) |>
  filter(!is.na(sample_id) & sample_id != "") |>
  filter(group %in% GROUP_LEVELS) |>
  transmute(
    sample_id,
    group = factor(group, levels = GROUP_LEVELS),
    age = as.numeric(.data[[age_col]]),
    bmi = as.numeric(.data[[bmi_col]]),
    disease_duration = as.numeric(.data[[dur_col]]),
    constipation = factor(as.integer(.data[[con_col]]), levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No","Yes")),
    levodopa_dose = if (!is.na(dose_col)) as.numeric(.data[[dose_col]]) else NA_real_
  )

stopifnot(nrow(meta) == 40)

# sample order: GR then MR, within group by sample_id
meta <- meta |>
  arrange(group, sample_id)
sample_order <- meta$sample_id
meta_rn <- meta |> column_to_rownames("sample_id")

## ---------- read 16S table (tab-delimited with .xls extension) ----------
dt <- read.delim(gzfile(INPUT_16S), sep = "\t", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

id_col  <- if ("#ID" %in% names(dt)) "#ID" else names(dt)[1]
tax_col <- if ("taxonomy" %in% names(dt)) "taxonomy" else if ("taxon" %in% names(dt)) "taxon" else NA_character_
stopifnot(!is.na(tax_col))

sample_cols <- names(dt)[str_detect(names(dt), "^PD\\d+$")]
keep_samples <- intersect(sample_order, sample_cols)
stopifnot(length(keep_samples) == 40)
keep_samples <- sample_order

asv_id <- as.character(dt[[id_col]])
mat_asv <- dt[, keep_samples, drop = FALSE]
mat_asv[] <- lapply(mat_asv, as.numeric)
mat_asv <- as.matrix(mat_asv)
rownames(mat_asv) <- asv_id

tax_tbl <- tibble(asv_id = asv_id, taxonomy_raw = dt[[tax_col]]) |>
  bind_cols(parse_tax_16s(dt[[tax_col]])) |>
  mutate(genus = fill_unknown(genus, "genus"))

## ---------- aggregate to genus & filter ----------
map_asv_genus <- setNames(tax_tbl$genus, tax_tbl$asv_id)
mat_genus <- aggregate_counts(mat_asv, map_asv_genus)

prev_all <- rowMeans(mat_genus > 0)
tot <- rowSums(mat_genus)
keep <- (prev_all >= MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL) & (tot >= MIN_TOTAL_COUNT)
mat_genus_f <- mat_genus[keep, , drop = FALSE]

dir.create(OUT_ROOT, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_tsv0(tibble(
  n_total = nrow(mat_genus),
  n_keep = nrow(mat_genus_f),
  min_prevalence_all = MIN_PREVALENCE_ALL,
  min_total_count = MIN_TOTAL_COUNT
), file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest_filter_summary_Genus.tsv"))

saveRDS(mat_genus_f, file.path(OUT_ROOT, "genus_counts_filtered.rds"), compress = "xz")

## ---------- compute CLR ----------
clr_genus <- clr_transform(mat_genus_f, pseudocount = PSEUDOCOUNT)  # features x samples
saveRDS(clr_genus, file.path(OUT_ROOT, "genus_CLR_features_by_sample.rds"), compress = "xz")

## ---------- model definitions ----------
models <- list(
  unadjusted = list(type = "clr", X = NULL),
  primary = list(type = "resid",
                 X = model.matrix(~ age + bmi + disease_duration + constipation, data = meta)),
  sensitivity_add_dose = list(type = "resid",
                              X = model.matrix(~ age + bmi + disease_duration + constipation + levodopa_dose, data = meta))
)

## ---------- run per model ----------
for (mname in names(models)) {
  out_dir <- file.path(OUT_ROOT, mname)
  dir_init(out_dir)
  write_tsv0(tibble(model = mname, p_cutoff = P_CUTOFF,
                    cluster_rows = CLUSTER_ROWS, cluster_cols = CLUSTER_COLS),
             file.path(out_dir, "00_manifest", "params.tsv"))

  # build test matrix (samples x features)
  Y <- t(clr_genus)  # samples x features
  rownames(Y) <- colnames(clr_genus)
  colnames(Y) <- rownames(clr_genus)

  if (models[[mname]]$type == "resid") {
    Y <- residualize_matrix(Y, models[[mname]]$X)
  }

  # compute wilcoxon per feature (MR vs GR)
  idx_gr <- which(meta$group == "PD_GR")
  idx_mr <- which(meta$group == "PD_MR")

  feats <- colnames(Y)
  stats <- t(vapply(feats, function(f) {
    wilcox_one(Y[idx_mr, f], Y[idx_gr, f])
  }, numeric(5)))

  res <- tibble(
    feature = feats,
    effect_median_diff = stats[, "median_diff"],
    W = stats[, "W"],
    U = stats[, "U"],
    rank_biserial = stats[, "rank_biserial"],
    p_value = stats[, "p_value"]
  ) |>
    mutate(q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
           direction = case_when(effect_median_diff > 0 ~ "PD_MR>PD_GR",
                                 effect_median_diff < 0 ~ "PD_MR<PD_GR",
                                 TRUE ~ "NA"),
           level = "Genus")

  write_tsv0(res, file.path(out_dir, "tables", "wilcoxon_all_results.tsv"))

  # select p<0.05; fallback to top N if none
  sel <- res |> filter(p_value < P_CUTOFF) |> arrange(p_value)
  note <- ""
  if (nrow(sel) == 0) {
    sel <- res |> arrange(p_value) |> slice_head(n = min(FALLBACK_TOP_N, nrow(res)))
    note <- paste0("No features with p<", P_CUTOFF, "; fallback to top ", nrow(sel), " by p.")
  } else {
    note <- paste0("Selected features: p<", P_CUTOFF, " (n=", nrow(sel), ").")
  }
  writeLines(note, con = file.path(out_dir, "logs", "selection_note.txt"))
  write_tsv0(sel, file.path(out_dir, "tables", "selected_by_p.tsv"))

  sel_feats <- sel$feature

  # matrices for heatmap
  mat_test_feat_by_samp <- t(Y[, sel_feats, drop = FALSE])  # features x samples
  mat_test_feat_by_samp <- mat_test_feat_by_samp[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]

  mat_z <- row_zscore(mat_test_feat_by_samp)

  # output reproducible tables
  write_tsv0(as.data.frame(mat_test_feat_by_samp) |> rownames_to_column("feature"),
             file.path(out_dir, "tables", "heatmap_matrix_testvalue_wide.tsv"))
  write_tsv0(as.data.frame(mat_z) |> rownames_to_column("feature"),
             file.path(out_dir, "tables", "heatmap_matrix_zscore_wide.tsv"))
  write_tsv0(meta, file.path(out_dir, "tables", "sample_annotation.tsv"))

  # per-sample long (for reproducing any plot)
  long <- as.data.frame(mat_test_feat_by_samp) |>
    rownames_to_column("feature") |>
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_order), names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "test_value") |>
    left_join(as.data.frame(mat_z) |> rownames_to_column("feature") |>
                pivot_longer(cols = all_of(sample_order), names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "z_value"),
              by = c("feature","sample_id")) |>
    left_join(meta, by = "sample_id") |>
    left_join(sel |> select(feature, p_value, q_value, effect_median_diff, rank_biserial, direction),
              by = "feature")
  write_tsv0(long, file.path(out_dir, "tables", "per_sample_heatmap_long.tsv"))

  # plot heatmap
  anno_col <- data.frame(group = meta$group)
  rownames(anno_col) <- meta$sample_id
  anno_col <- anno_col[sample_order, , drop = FALSE]

  out_pdf <- file.path(out_dir, "figures", paste0("Genus_heatmap_p", P_CUTOFF, "_", mname, ".pdf"))
  out_png <- file.path(out_dir, "figures", paste0("Genus_heatmap_p", P_CUTOFF, "_", mname, ".png"))

  ok <- plot_heatmap_pheatmap(mat_z, anno_col, out_pdf, out_png, CLUSTER_ROWS, CLUSTER_COLS)
  if (!ok) {
    # fallback to ggplot heatmap
    plot_heatmap_gg(mat_z, sample_order, out_pdf, out_png)
  }

  message("Done heatmap: ", mname, " | features=", nrow(sel))
}

message("All genus heatmaps done -> ", OUT_ROOT)
```

## Fig1C-3

```{r fig1c_3, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## =========================
## 09_scatter_16S_updrs3_Enterococcus.R
## One-figure-per-file scatter plots (PDF required)
## - X: CLR (or adjusted residual) of feature
## - Y: updrs3_reduction_pct (or adjusted residual)
## - Plot types per feature per model:
##   1) groupwise: 2 lines (PD_GR & PD_MR) on SAME plot
##   2) overall: 1 line (all samples) on SAME plot
## - Levels:
##   Genus: Enterococcus
##   Species: all species under genus Enterococcus
## - Models:
##   unadjusted / primary / sensitivity_add_dose
## Inputs in wd:
##   metadata.csv
##   table_filtered_w_tax.tsv.gz  或  table_f_even_depth_w_tax.tsv.gz
## =========================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(janitor)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
})

## ---------- params ----------
META_FILE <- "metadata.csv"
INPUT_16S <- "table_f_even_depth_w_tax.tsv.gz"  #抽平/未抽平

OUT_ROOT <- "results_16S_scatter_updrs3_even" #抽平/未抽平
dir.create(OUT_ROOT, showWarnings = FALSE)

GROUP_LEVELS <- c("PD_GR","PD_MR")  # GR first
PSEUDOCOUNT <- 0.5

MAKE_PDF <- TRUE
MAKE_PNG <- TRUE

# Colors consistent: GR green, MR red
COL_MAP <- c(PD_GR = "#7CAE00", PD_MR = "#F8766D")
LAB_MAP <- c(PD_GR = "GR", PD_MR = "MR")

MODELS <- c("unadjusted","primary","sensitivity_add_dose")

## ---------- helpers ----------
read_csv_smart <- function(path) {
  tryCatch(
    readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = "GB18030")),
    error = function(e) readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))
  )
}
normalize_id <- function(x) x |> as.character() |> str_trim() |> str_replace_all("\\s+", "")
find_col <- function(df, patterns) {
  nms <- names(df)
  for (p in patterns) {
    hit <- nms[str_detect(nms, regex(p, ignore_case = TRUE))]
    if (length(hit) > 0) return(hit[1])
  }
  NA_character_
}
dir_init <- function(path) {
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "tables"), showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "figures_pdf"), showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "figures_png"), showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(path, "logs"), showWarnings = FALSE)
}
write_tsv0 <- function(x, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  readr::write_tsv(x, path)
}
fill_unknown <- function(x, label) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x=="" | x=="NA"] <- paste0("Unassigned_", label)
  x
}
parse_percent <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "%", "")
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}
safe_slug <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "_+", "_")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "^_|_$", "")
  x
}

parse_tax_16s <- function(tax) {
  parts <- str_split(as.character(tax), ";", simplify = TRUE)
  get_rank <- function(row, key) {
    cand <- row[str_detect(row, paste0("^\\s*", key, "_+"))]
    if (length(cand) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    v <- str_trim(cand[1])
    v <- str_replace(v, paste0("^\\s*", key, "_+"), "")
    if (v == "" || v == "NA") NA_character_ else v
  }
  tibble(
    genus   = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "g"),
    species = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, key = "s")
  )
}
aggregate_counts <- function(mat_feat_by_samp, feature_to_group_named) {
  grp <- feature_to_group_named[rownames(mat_feat_by_samp)]
  rowsum(mat_feat_by_samp, group = grp, reorder = TRUE)
}
clr_transform <- function(mat_feat_by_samp, pseudocount = 0.5) {
  x <- mat_feat_by_samp + pseudocount
  x <- sweep(x, 2, colSums(x), "/")
  lx <- log(x)
  sweep(lx, 2, colMeans(lx), "-")
}

# residualize vector on covariates (no group term)
resid_on_covars <- function(df, value, covars) {
  keep <- complete.cases(df[, covars, drop = FALSE]) & is.finite(value)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(value))
  if (sum(keep) < 6) return(out)
  X <- model.matrix(as.formula(paste("~", paste(covars, collapse = " + "))), data = df[keep, , drop = FALSE])
  fit <- lm.fit(X, value[keep])
  out[keep] <- fit$residuals
  out
}

spearman_fast <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 6) return(c(rho=NA_real_, p=NA_real_, n=n))
  rho <- suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, method="spearman"))
  if (is.na(rho)) return(c(rho=NA_real_, p=NA_real_, n=n))
  rho2 <- min(0.999999, max(-0.999999, rho))
  tval <- rho2 * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - rho2^2))
  p <- 2 * pt(-abs(tval), df = n - 2)
  c(rho=rho, p=p, n=n)
}

make_xy <- function(df, x_raw, y_raw, model, mode = c("overall","within_group")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)

  cov_primary <- c("age","bmi","disease_duration","constipation")
  cov_sens <- c(cov_primary, "levodopa_dose")

  if (model == "unadjusted") {
    df$x_used <- x_raw
    df$y_used <- y_raw
    return(df)
  }

  covars <- if (model == "primary") cov_primary else cov_sens

  if (mode == "overall") {
    df$x_used <- resid_on_covars(df, x_raw, covars)
    df$y_used <- resid_on_covars(df, y_raw, covars)
  } else {
    df$x_used <- NA_real_
    df$y_used <- NA_real_
    for (g in levels(df$group)) {
      idx <- which(df$group == g)
      df$x_used[idx] <- resid_on_covars(df[idx, , drop=FALSE], x_raw[idx], covars)
      df$y_used[idx] <- resid_on_covars(df[idx, , drop=FALSE], y_raw[idx], covars)
    }
  }
  df
}

plot_groupwise_onefile <- function(df, title, xlab, ylab, out_pdf, out_png) {
  # Spearman by group (on x_used/y_used)
  st_gr <- spearman_fast(df$x_used[df$group=="PD_GR"], df$y_used[df$group=="PD_GR"])
  st_mr <- spearman_fast(df$x_used[df$group=="PD_MR"], df$y_used[df$group=="PD_MR"])

  lab1 <- sprintf("GR: rho=%.3f, p=%.2g, n=%d", st_gr["rho"], st_gr["p"], as.integer(st_gr["n"]))
  lab2 <- sprintf("MR: rho=%.3f, p=%.2g, n=%d", st_mr["rho"], st_mr["p"], as.integer(st_mr["n"]))

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x_used, y = y_used, color = group)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.6, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = group), method = "lm", se = TRUE, fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.25) +
    scale_color_manual(values = COL_MAP, breaks = names(LAB_MAP), labels = LAB_MAP) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = title, x = xlab, y = ylab, color = "group") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = lab1, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 2.0, size = 4) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = lab2, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 3.2, size = 4)

  if (MAKE_PDF) ggsave(out_pdf, p, width = 7.8, height = 6.0)
  if (MAKE_PNG) ggsave(out_png, p, width = 7.8, height = 6.0, dpi = 300)
}

plot_overall_onefile <- function(df, title, xlab, ylab, out_pdf, out_png) {
  st <- spearman_fast(df$x_used, df$y_used)
  lab <- sprintf("Spearman rho=%.3f\np=%.2g\nn=%d", st["rho"], st["p"], as.integer(st["n"]))

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x_used, y = y_used)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = group), size = 2.6, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.25) +
    scale_color_manual(values = COL_MAP, breaks = names(LAB_MAP), labels = LAB_MAP) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = title, x = xlab, y = ylab, color = "group") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = lab, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 4)

  if (MAKE_PDF) ggsave(out_pdf, p, width = 7.8, height = 6.0)
  if (MAKE_PNG) ggsave(out_png, p, width = 7.8, height = 6.0, dpi = 300)
}

## ---------- load metadata ----------
meta_raw <- read_csv_smart(META_FILE) |> janitor::clean_names(replace = c("\u03bc"="u"))

sample_col <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^sample$"))
group_col  <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^group$"))
age_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^age$"))
bmi_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("^bmi"))
dur_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("disease_duration"))
con_col    <- find_col(meta_raw, c("constipation"))
dose_col   <- find_col(meta_raw, c("levodopa.*dose|levodopa_daily_dose"))
updrs_col  <- find_col(meta_raw, c("mds.*updrs.*iii.*reduction", "updrs.*iii.*reduction", "reduction.*updrs.*iii"))

stopifnot(!is.na(sample_col), !is.na(group_col), !is.na(updrs_col))

meta <- meta_raw |>
  mutate(sample_id = normalize_id(.data[[sample_col]]),
         group = .data[[group_col]]) |>
  filter(group %in% GROUP_LEVELS) |>
  transmute(
    sample_id,
    group = factor(group, levels = GROUP_LEVELS),
    age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[age_col]])),
    bmi = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[bmi_col]])),
    disease_duration = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[dur_col]])),
    constipation = factor(as.integer(.data[[con_col]]), levels=c(0,1), labels=c("No","Yes")),
    levodopa_dose = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[dose_col]])),
    updrs3_reduction_pct = parse_percent(.data[[updrs_col]])
  ) |>
  arrange(group, sample_id)

stopifnot(nrow(meta) == 40)
sample_order <- meta$sample_id

write_tsv0(meta, file.path(OUT_ROOT, "00_manifest_metadata_model_40.tsv"))

## ---------- read 16S table ----------
dt <- read.delim(gzfile(INPUT_16S), sep = "\t", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
id_col  <- if ("#ID" %in% names(dt)) "#ID" else names(dt)[1]
tax_col <- if ("taxonomy" %in% names(dt)) "taxonomy" else if ("taxon" %in% names(dt)) "taxon" else NA_character_
stopifnot(!is.na(tax_col))

sample_cols <- names(dt)[str_detect(names(dt), "^PD\\d+$")]
keep_samples <- intersect(sample_order, sample_cols)
stopifnot(length(keep_samples) == 40)
keep_samples <- sample_order

asv_id <- as.character(dt[[id_col]])
mat_asv <- dt[, keep_samples, drop=FALSE]
mat_asv[] <- lapply(mat_asv, as.numeric)
mat_asv <- as.matrix(mat_asv)
rownames(mat_asv) <- asv_id

tax_tbl <- tibble(asv_id = asv_id, taxonomy_raw = dt[[tax_col]]) |>
  bind_cols(parse_tax_16s(dt[[tax_col]])) |>
  mutate(
    genus = fill_unknown(genus, "genus"),
    species = fill_unknown(species, "species")
  )

## ---------- build genus/species matrices + CLR ----------
mat_genus <- aggregate_counts(mat_asv, setNames(tax_tbl$genus, tax_tbl$asv_id))
mat_species_all <- aggregate_counts(mat_asv, setNames(tax_tbl$species, tax_tbl$asv_id))

clr_genus <- clr_transform(mat_genus, pseudocount = PSEUDOCOUNT)
clr_species <- clr_transform(mat_species_all, pseudocount = PSEUDOCOUNT)

if (!("Enterococcus" %in% rownames(clr_genus))) stop("Genus 'Enterococcus' not found in genus matrix.")

enterococcus_species <- rownames(clr_species)[str_detect(rownames(clr_species), "^Enterococcus\\b")]
if (length(enterococcus_species) == 0) stop("No Enterococcus species found (species names not starting with 'Enterococcus').")

## ---------- output folders ----------
genus_root <- file.path(OUT_ROOT, "Genus_Enterococcus")
species_root <- file.path(OUT_ROOT, "Species_Enterococcus")
dir_init(genus_root); dir_init(species_root)

write_tsv0(tibble(species = enterococcus_species),
           file.path(species_root, "tables", "enterococcus_species_list.tsv"))

## ---------- run all models ----------
for (m in MODELS) {

  ## ===== Genus Enterococcus =====
  out_dir <- file.path(genus_root, m)
  dir_init(out_dir)

  x_raw <- as.numeric(clr_genus["Enterococcus", sample_order])
  y_raw <- meta$updrs3_reduction_pct

  df_g <- make_xy(meta, x_raw, y_raw, model = m, mode = "within_group")
  df_o <- make_xy(meta, x_raw, y_raw, model = m, mode = "overall")

  write_tsv0(df_g |> mutate(feature="Enterococcus", level="Genus", model=m, plot_type="groupwise"),
             file.path(out_dir, "tables", "scatter_data_groupwise.tsv"))
  write_tsv0(df_o |> mutate(feature="Enterococcus", level="Genus", model=m, plot_type="overall"),
             file.path(out_dir, "tables", "scatter_data_overall.tsv"))

  xlab <- if (m=="unadjusted") "Enterococcus (CLR, genus level)" else paste0("Enterococcus (adj residual, ", m, ")")
  ylab <- if (m=="unadjusted") "MDS-UPDRS-III reduction (%)" else paste0("UPDRS-III reduction (adj residual, ", m, ")")

  plot_groupwise_onefile(df_g,
    title = paste0("Genus Enterococcus vs UPDRS-III reduction (", m, ")"),
    xlab=xlab, ylab=ylab,
    out_pdf=file.path(out_dir, "figures_pdf", "Genus_Enterococcus_groupwise.pdf"),
    out_png=file.path(out_dir, "figures_png", "Genus_Enterococcus_groupwise.png"))

  plot_overall_onefile(df_o,
    title = paste0("Genus Enterococcus vs UPDRS-III reduction (overall, ", m, ")"),
    xlab=xlab, ylab=ylab,
    out_pdf=file.path(out_dir, "figures_pdf", "Genus_Enterococcus_overall.pdf"),
    out_png=file.path(out_dir, "figures_png", "Genus_Enterococcus_overall.png"))

  ## ===== Species: all Enterococcus species =====
  out_dir2 <- file.path(species_root, m)
  dir_init(out_dir2)

  sum_rows <- list()
  long_g_all <- list()
  long_o_all <- list()

  for (sp in enterococcus_species) {
    sp_slug <- safe_slug(sp)

    x_raw_sp <- as.numeric(clr_species[sp, sample_order])
    y_raw_sp <- meta$updrs3_reduction_pct

    df_gs <- make_xy(meta, x_raw_sp, y_raw_sp, model = m, mode = "within_group") |>
      mutate(feature = sp, level="Species", model=m, plot_type="groupwise")
    df_os <- make_xy(meta, x_raw_sp, y_raw_sp, model = m, mode = "overall") |>
      mutate(feature = sp, level="Species", model=m, plot_type="overall")

    long_g_all[[length(long_g_all)+1]] <- df_gs
    long_o_all[[length(long_o_all)+1]] <- df_os

    st_gr <- spearman_fast(df_gs$x_used[df_gs$group=="PD_GR"], df_gs$y_used[df_gs$group=="PD_GR"])
    st_mr <- spearman_fast(df_gs$x_used[df_gs$group=="PD_MR"], df_gs$y_used[df_gs$group=="PD_MR"])
    st_all <- spearman_fast(df_os$x_used, df_os$y_used)

    sum_rows[[length(sum_rows)+1]] <- tibble(
      feature = sp, model = m,
      rho_GR = st_gr["rho"], p_GR = st_gr["p"], n_GR = st_gr["n"],
      rho_MR = st_mr["rho"], p_MR = st_mr["p"], n_MR = st_mr["n"],
      rho_all = st_all["rho"], p_all = st_all["p"], n_all = st_all["n"]
    )

    xlab_sp <- if (m=="unadjusted") paste0(sp, " (CLR, species)") else paste0(sp, " (adj residual, ", m, ")")
    ylab_sp <- if (m=="unadjusted") "MDS-UPDRS-III reduction (%)" else paste0("UPDRS-III reduction (adj residual, ", m, ")")

    # One file per plot
    plot_groupwise_onefile(df_gs,
      title = paste0("Species ", sp, " vs UPDRS-III reduction (", m, ")"),
      xlab=xlab_sp, ylab=ylab_sp,
      out_pdf=file.path(out_dir2, "figures_pdf", paste0("Species_", sp_slug, "_groupwise.pdf")),
      out_png=file.path(out_dir2, "figures_png", paste0("Species_", sp_slug, "_groupwise.png")))

    plot_overall_onefile(df_os,
      title = paste0("Species ", sp, " vs UPDRS-III reduction (overall, ", m, ")"),
      xlab=xlab_sp, ylab=ylab_sp,
      out_pdf=file.path(out_dir2, "figures_pdf", paste0("Species_", sp_slug, "_overall.pdf")),
      out_png=file.path(out_dir2, "figures_png", paste0("Species_", sp_slug, "_overall.png")))
  }

  # Save per-sample long tables and summary (per model)
  write_tsv0(bind_rows(long_g_all),
             file.path(out_dir2, "tables", "scatter_data_groupwise_all_species_long.tsv"))
  write_tsv0(bind_rows(long_o_all),
             file.path(out_dir2, "tables", "scatter_data_overall_all_species_long.tsv"))
  write_tsv0(bind_rows(sum_rows),
             file.path(out_dir2, "tables", "species_correlation_summary.tsv"))

  message("Done model: ", m)
}

message("All scatterplots done -> ", OUT_ROOT)
```

write_feature_sample_wide_with_stats <- function(test_feat_by_samp,
                                                 res_df,
                                                 sample_order,
                                                 out_all_path,
                                                 out_p05_path,
                                                 p_cutoff = 0.05) {
  # test_feat_by_samp: features x samples (colnames are sample IDs)
  # res_df must contain: feature, p_value, q_value, effect_median_diff, rank_biserial, W, U, direction

  # 1) feature x sample (wide)
  wide_vals <- as.data.frame(test_feat_by_samp[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature")

  # 2) stats columns
  stats_cols <- res_df |>
    select(feature,
           effect_median_diff, rank_biserial, W, U,
           p_value, q_value, direction)

  # 3) merge and order columns: feature + sample cols + stats cols
  wide_all <- wide_vals |>
    left_join(stats_cols, by = "feature")

  wide_all <- wide_all[, c("feature", sample_order,
                           "effect_median_diff", "rank_biserial", "W", "U",
                           "p_value", "q_value", "direction"), drop = FALSE]

  write_tsv0(wide_all, out_all_path)

  # 4) p<0.05 filtered
  wide_p <- wide_all |>
    filter(!is.na(p_value) & p_value < p_cutoff)

  write_tsv0(wide_p, out_p05_path)
}

fill_unknown <- function(x, label) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x=="" | x=="NA"] <- paste0("Unassigned_", label)
  x
}

safe_mode <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "NA"]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
}

collapse_ids <- function(ids, max_n = 200) {
  ids <- as.character(ids)
  ids <- ids[!is.na(ids) & ids != ""]
  if (length(ids) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  if (length(ids) <= max_n) return(paste(ids, collapse = ";"))
  head_part <- paste(ids[seq_len(max_n)], collapse = ";")
  paste0(head_part, ";...(+", length(ids) - max_n, " more)")
}

row_zscore <- function(mat_feat_by_samp) {
  mu <- rowMeans(mat_feat_by_samp, na.rm = TRUE)
  sdv <- apply(mat_feat_by_samp, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  sdv[sdv == 0 | is.na(sdv)] <- 1
  sweep(sweep(mat_feat_by_samp, 1, mu, "-"), 1, sdv, "/")
}

clr_transform <- function(mat_feat_by_samp, pseudocount = 0.01) {
  x <- mat_feat_by_samp + pseudocount
  x <- sweep(x, 2, colSums(x), "/")
  lx <- log(x)
  sweep(lx, 2, colMeans(lx), "-")
}

residualize_matrix <- function(Y_samp_by_feat, X_design) {
  qrX <- qr(X_design)
  qr.resid(qrX, Y_samp_by_feat)
}

# Wilcoxon summary: U from ranks => rank-biserial in [-1,1]
wilcox_one <- function(x_mr, x_gr) {
  n1 <- length(x_mr); n2 <- length(x_gr)
  wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x_mr, x_gr, exact = FALSE))
  p <- wt$p.value
  Wstat <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)

  z <- c(x_mr, x_gr)
  r <- rank(z, ties.method = "average")
  Wrank <- sum(r[seq_len(n1)])
  U <- Wrank - n1*(n1+1)/2
  rb <- (2*U)/(n1*n2) - 1
  rb <- max(-1, min(1, rb))
  med_diff <- median(x_mr, na.rm = TRUE) - median(x_gr, na.rm = TRUE)
  c(p_value=p, W=Wstat, U=U, rank_biserial=rb, median_diff=med_diff)
}

mean_ra_fast <- function(mat_feat_by_samp) {
  tot <- colSums(mat_feat_by_samp)
  w <- 1 / tot
  as.numeric(mat_feat_by_samp %*% w) / length(w)
}

filter_matrix <- function(mat_feat_by_samp, meta,
                          min_prev_all, min_total,
                          min_prev_by_group = NA_real_,
                          min_mean_ra = NA_real_) {
  prev_all <- rowMeans(mat_feat_by_samp > 0)
  tot <- rowSums(mat_feat_by_samp)

  keep <- (prev_all >= min_prev_all) & (tot >= min_total)

  if (!is.na(min_prev_by_group)) {
    idx_gr <- which(meta$group=="PD_GR")
    idx_mr <- which(meta$group=="PD_MR")
    prev_gr <- rowMeans(mat_feat_by_samp[, idx_gr, drop=FALSE] > 0)
    prev_mr <- rowMeans(mat_feat_by_samp[, idx_mr, drop=FALSE] > 0)
    keep <- keep & (prev_gr >= min_prev_by_group) & (prev_mr >= min_prev_by_group)
  } else {
    prev_gr <- prev_mr <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(mat_feat_by_samp))
  }

  if (!is.na(min_mean_ra)) {
    mra <- mean_ra_fast(mat_feat_by_samp)
    keep <- keep & (mra >= min_mean_ra)
  } else {
    mra <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(mat_feat_by_samp))
  }

  list(
    mat = mat_feat_by_samp[keep, , drop=FALSE],
    diagnostics = tibble(feature=rownames(mat_feat_by_samp),
                         prev_all=prev_all, prev_gr=prev_gr, prev_mr=prev_mr,
                         total=tot, mean_ra=mra, keep=keep),
    summary = tibble(n_total=nrow(mat_feat_by_samp), n_keep=sum(keep),
                     min_prev_all=min_prev_all, min_total=min_total,
                     min_prev_by_group=min_prev_by_group, min_mean_ra=min_mean_ra)
  )
}

aggregate_sum <- function(mat, map_named) {
  grp <- map_named[rownames(mat)]
  rowsum(mat, group = grp, reorder = TRUE)
}

parse_virus_tax <- function(x) {
  parts <- str_split(as.character(x), ";", simplify = TRUE)
  get_rank <- function(row, prefix) {
    y <- row[str_detect(row, paste0("^\\s*", prefix))]
    if (length(y)==0) return(NA_character_)
    str_replace(str_trim(y[1]), paste0("^", prefix), "")
  }
  tibble(
    realm   = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, prefix="r__"),
    kingdom = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, prefix="k__"),
    phylum  = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, prefix="p__"),
    class   = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, prefix="c__"),
    order   = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, prefix="o__"),
    family  = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, prefix="f__"),
    genus   = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, prefix="g__"),
    species = apply(parts, 1, get_rank, prefix="s__")
  )
}

# NOW outputs host_genus + host_species; host_display stays genus (for Host-level)
parse_host_display <- function(host_field) {
  host_field <- as.character(host_field)
  host_field[host_field %in% c("-", "", "NA")] <- NA_character_

  rank <- ifelse(!is.na(host_field) & str_detect(host_field, ":"), str_split_fixed(host_field, ":", 2)[,1], NA_character_)
  name <- ifelse(!is.na(host_field) & str_detect(host_field, ":"), str_split_fixed(host_field, ":", 2)[,2], host_field)
  name <- str_trim(name)

  host_species <- ifelse(!is.na(rank) & rank=="species" & !is.na(name) & name!="", name, NA_character_)
  host_genus <- ifelse(!is.na(rank) & rank=="genus" & !is.na(name) & name!="", name,
                       ifelse(!is.na(host_species) & str_detect(host_species, "\\s+"),
                              str_split_fixed(host_species, "\\s+", 2)[,1],
                              NA_character_))
  host_genus <- ifelse(!is.na(host_genus) & host_genus!="", host_genus, "Unassigned_host")

  tibble(
    host_rank   = rank,
    host_name   = name,
    host_genus  = host_genus,
    host_species= host_species,
    host_display= host_genus
  )
}

plot_heatmap <- function(mat_z, anno_col, out_pdf, out_png,
                         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE) {
  # disable clustering if dimension <2
  cr <- isTRUE(cluster_rows) && nrow(mat_z) >= 2
  cc <- isTRUE(cluster_cols) && ncol(mat_z) >= 2

  if (requireNamespace("pheatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ann <- as.data.frame(anno_col); rownames(ann) <- colnames(mat_z)
    if (MAKE_PDF) {
      pdf(out_pdf, width = 9, height = max(4, 0.18*nrow(mat_z)+2))
      pheatmap::pheatmap(mat_z,
                         cluster_rows = cr,
                         cluster_cols = cc,
                         annotation_col = ann,
                         show_colnames = FALSE,
                         fontsize_row = 8)
      dev.off()
    }
    if (MAKE_PNG) {
      png(out_png, width = 2200, height = max(1400, 40*nrow(mat_z)+600), res = 300)
      pheatmap::pheatmap(mat_z,
                         cluster_rows = cr,
                         cluster_cols = cc,
                         annotation_col = ann,
                         show_colnames = FALSE,
                         fontsize_row = 8)
      dev.off()
    }
  } else {
    df <- as.data.frame(mat_z) |>
      rownames_to_column("feature") |>
      pivot_longer(-feature, names_to="sample_id", values_to="z")
    df$sample_id <- factor(df$sample_id, levels = colnames(mat_z))
    df$feature <- factor(df$feature, levels = rev(rownames(mat_z)))

    p <- ggplot(df, aes(sample_id, feature, fill=z)) +
      geom_tile() +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(), axis.ticks.x=element_blank()) +
      labs(x=NULL, y=NULL, fill="Z")

    if (MAKE_PDF) ggsave(out_pdf, p, width=9, height=max(4,0.18*nrow(mat_z)+2))
    if (MAKE_PNG) ggsave(out_png, p, width=9, height=max(4,0.18*nrow(mat_z)+2), dpi=300)
  }
}

## wide writer: rows = samples, cols = features
write_matrix_wide_sample_rows <- function(mat_feat_by_samp, out_path, sample_order) {
  # mat_feat_by_samp: features x samples
  mat <- mat_feat_by_samp[, sample_order, drop=FALSE]
  wide <- as.data.frame(t(mat))
  wide <- tibble::rownames_to_column(wide, "sample_id")
  write_tsv0(wide, out_path)
}
